split: fixed seed-42 WED TRAIN physical-group DEV carve
recommendation_note: No candidate passes every predeclared criterion; keep the frozen reference.
execution_notes: An initial launch completed the matched DeepLabV3 control, then exited at the high-resolution run because the ASPP global-pooling BatchNorm received a singleton batch.

The high-resolution run completed on retry with physical batch size 1, gradient accumulation 2, and ASPP global-pooling BatchNorm held in evaluation mode; it therefore has this documented training-side adjustment in addition to resolution and is not a perfectly isolated resolution-only ablation.
No GPU out-of-memory event occurred; all seven final candidates completed 10 epochs and were frozen before DEV inference.

definitions.per_class_iou: global confusion-matrix IoU; absent GT classes retain IoU 0 but are excluded from macro food IoU
definitions.region_matching: 8-connected components per semantic class; one-to-one Hungarian IoU >= 0.5
definitions.merge_fragmentation: semantic raster connected-component proxies only; WED has no instance IDs
definitions.small_region_bins: GT component area as fraction of full image: <0.10%, 0.10-0.25%, 0.25-0.50%, >=0.50%
definitions.boundary: class-wise binary boundaries with 3-pixel tolerance at original DEV resolution
definitions.latency: batch-1 FP32 synchronized model forward plus logits resize; two warmups excluded
definitions.bootstrap: 10,000 paired physical-meal-group bootstrap resamples, seed 42; each resample recomputes pooled metric sufficient counts
